Motorists should allow plenty of extra travel time on roads approaching Olympic Park including the M4 Mwy, Homebush Bay Dr, Concord Rd, Lane Cove Rd, Parramatta Rd, Centenary Dr and Silverwater Rd.

  • PARKING: Car parks are expected to be in high demand, fans are urged to pre-book parking online ahead of time to secure a space. A flat rate $40 parking fee applies. 
  • If you have pre-booked your parking, follow the directions of staff and have your parking ticket ready to show at the car park entry. If you haven't pre-booked parking don't drive to Olympic Park.
  • Carpool with your group and allow plenty of extra travel time as traffic will be heavy.
  • Alternatively, consider parking at a nearby train station commuter car park and continuing your trip by train to Olympic Park, at no extra cost.

Sydney Olympic Park Authority will close local roads in the precinct and traffic congestion is expected before and after the match. For road closure details, visit the Sydney Olympic Park Authority interactive map.

AFL Preliminary Final: Sydney Swans v Fremantle Dockers at the SCG. First bounce at 7.40pm, full time at 9.20pm.

With up to 40,000 footy fans attending, significant traffic delays are expected on roads approaching Moore Park.

Motorists should allow plenty of extra travel time on roads including the Eastern Distributor, Moore Park Rd, Cleveland St, Anzac Pde and Lang Rd.

Attendees are urged to catch public transport and leave the car at home to avoid traffic delays and the high demand for parking.

Changed traffic conditions:

  • Driver Avenue will be partially closed outside the stadium from 3.30pm and will reopen once crowds have safely cleared the area.  
  • No through-traffic will be available on Driver Avenue, however access to EP2 Kippax car park will be maintained via Moore Park Road and access to EP3 grass car park and drop-off areas will be maintained from Lang Road. Grass car parks open from 4.40pm.
  • Special event clearways will be in place on roads in Moore Park and surrounding areas from 3pm to midnight on sections of Albion Street, Lang Road and Moore Park Road, and from 6am to midnight on Cleveland Street and Fitzroy Street.   

Clearways are strict no-parking zones for all vehicle types, and apply even to local residents and TfNSW Mobility Scheme Permit holders. Check signs carefully as vehicles left in clearways will be towed and a fee applies. If your vehicle is towed, you can search your vehicle registration at the Find My Car website to find its new location, or alternatively call 132 701 to speak to an operator.
